settings.title: Discover the Stories Behind the Pages
A writer, dreamer, and lover of stories that connect

settings.editor: Hello, I’m Claudia Yeoh, an author with a passion for crafting narratives that inspire and resonate. My journey as a writer began with a love for reading and a curiosity about the world. Through my stories, I aim to transport readers to different realms while exploring universal themes of love, resilience, and self-discovery.

settings.title: How each tale comes to life

settings.editor: Creating a book is a journey, from the first spark of an idea to the final draft. I love sharing the creative process with my readers, giving you a glimpse into the work and dedication behind each chapter.

settings.description_text: People you feel like you’ve known forever
Stories that tug at your heartstrings

settings.title: Every story starts with a spark

settings.editor: Life is filled with extraordinary moments, people, and places that inspire me. From quiet afternoons in bustling cafes to the history of faraway lands, I find stories everywhere. My mission is to transform these inspirations into tales that bring readers closer to the human experience.

settings.title: "I love how easy it is to find quality ebooks here. It's my go-to platform."

settings.editor: A deep curiosity for history and culture
When I’m not writing, I’m finding joy in the little things. My life outside the pages is filled with activities that inspire my creative spirit and keep me grounded.

settings.description_text: Walks and hikes to clear my mind and gather inspiration
Quiet moments with a warm cup, often with a journal nearby
Discovering new cultures and stories waiting to be told

settings.title: Join me on this storytelling journey

settings.editor: I believe in building a connection with my readers beyond the pages. Whether through newsletters, book events, or social media, I love hearing your thoughts and sharing updates from my world.
